notes: Defect: promo code discount amount not displayed for return trip legs in Mozio email confirmation. The code already has outboundDiscount/returnDiscount fields in SanitizedMozioDispatch and MozioDispatchPrice, and mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch maps both. The bug likely originates upstream — either in how return-leg discounts are applied to the dispatch report price (apply-report-discounts.service.ts) or how the dispatch report price is constructed for Mozio submission (submit-reservations.mappers.ts), causing returnDiscount to be missing/zero when it should carry the promo amount.

notes: Reviewed openspec's 5 ACs — they cover the core scenarios well. Added 3 new criteria: (1) partial-application edge case where promo only applies to one leg of a return trip, ensuring the return leg without a discount doesn't erroneously show a promo section; (2) zero-amount return leg after promo discount, relevant because process-zero-amount-order.service.ts is listed in technical notes and zero-amount edge cases often break display logic; (3) explicit non-null/non-blank assertion for the return leg discount value, targeting the likely root cause described in openspec's notes where returnDiscount may be missing or zero when it should carry the promo amount. Flagged AC1/AC2 overlap for human awareness but kept both since they test distinct aspects (presence vs. consistency).
